basis: Configured study themes and methods; no unpublished findings or full thesis supplied

today.q: How do plural values and environmental justice alter the interpretation of urban ecosystem service demand?
outline: Define plural values in socio-ecological systems
Incorporate environmental justice into access and benefit metrics
Link justice considerations to environmental planning governance
today.pitfall: Treating service demand as uniform rather than shaped by unequal access and diverse values.
today.follow_up: How can planning governance integrate conflicting plural values in informal flatland and hillside areas?
today.bring: Frameworks for plural valuation and environmental justice in urban planning governance.
